method: Pinned existing text-gap reporter.analyze;10000 paired bootstrap resamples; ratio of per-arm kernel-time medians with exploratory95%CI. All six denominators/statuses preserved, no ratios inferred from incomplete cells, no aggregate score. Managed setup-inclusive counters separate from RSS; foreign managed counters unavailable; allocator movement raw. Compilation not measured by this micro campaign.

concurrent_analysis_context.clock_basis: UTC filesystem birth/mtime boundaries, not explicit process-clock receipts; exact process timestamps unavailable

analysis.basis: report stdoutlog birth/lastwrite and report.json creation; bootstrap report executed pinned CPU0, no shared admission

compression.basis: raw-windows.tar.gz birth/mtime; archive script set affinity0 before opening archive, no shared admission

archive_verification.basis: verification follows raw-log-index publication and completed before subsequent handoff creation; exact finish not logged, conservative upper bound only

concurrent_analysis_context.limitation: May overlap coordinator application samples. CPU0 affinity does not rule out shared-cache/memory/I/O effects. Preserve all samples and review overlap/noise; no reruns performed. Future substantial compression/verification uses shared admission or waits for application timings.
